runtime.entryListLimit: admin sitemap entry list clamps request limit by maxEntryListRows
runtime.refreshPlan: admin preview endpoint returns bounded refresh cost without writing sitemap entries or cache files
runtime.refreshPlanUi: ability page renders sitemap.refresh-plan as bounded refresh cost and cache policy tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.refreshLimit: manual refresh clamps rebuild count by maxRefreshRows
runtime.refreshResultUi: ability page renders sitemap.refresh as bounded refresh and cache write result table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.refreshUiLimit: ability page exposes refresh limit and sends it to both sitemap.refresh-plan and sitemap.refresh
runtime.rssLimit: RSS fallback item count is capped by maxRssRows
runtime.dirtyMetadata: admin stats reads sitemap/dirty.json and reports cacheDirty from dirty metadata
runtime.dirtyMetadataDetail: admin stats exposes dirtyReason, dirtyContentId and dirtyUpdateTime from sitemap/dirty.json for cache diagnostics
runtime.cacheFileDiagnostics: admin stats exposes cacheFiles with path, exists, sizeBytes and updateTimeText for sitemap.xml, sitemap-index.xml, rss.xml, robots.txt, cache.json and dirty.json
runtime.categoryBindIntegration: entry list, manual refresh candidate rows, and sitemap/RSS fallback rows prefer content_category_bind when content.category is enabled
runtime.accessIntegration: sitemap sync and refresh remove restricted content when content.access is enabled; public sitemap/RSS bypass stale cache and filter fallback rows when access is mounted
